sources.entry: Matomo - Web analytics that protects your data and your customers' privacy (alternative to Google Analytics). (Source Code) GPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: Matomo is a self-hosted PHP/MySQL web analytics platform, positioned as a privacy-focused, free software alternative to Google Analytics.
summary.what_it_does: Matomo is installed on your own web server and stores analytics data in your own database. After a short web-based installation, it gives you a JavaScript tracking code to paste into the pages you want to track, and reports are viewable in real time. Its features are built as plugins, so features can be added or removed, and the README lists e-commerce, goal, campaign, and custom variable tracking, email reports, a custom segment editor, geo location, and real-time visits and maps. It also provides an Analytics API for pulling statistics. The README mentions an optional VisitorGenerator plugin that creates fake data for experimentation.
how_to_run: Point your browser to the directory
Add the given JavaScript code to your pages
stack: MySQL 8.0 or greater, or MariaDB 10.6 or greater
notable: Data stays in your own database on your own server, with a full analytics API
Built as plugins that can be added or removed
Privacy controls configurable to respect visitor privacy
Hosted Matomo Cloud option with a 21-day free trial
caveats: Requires a PHP and MySQL/MariaDB server you run yourself
Paid professional support plans are offered; free support is via community forums
Matomo Cloud is a hosted paid service after the 21-day free trial
keywords: track website visitors on my own server
